name: euta
description: Explore a web app like a real user, turn it into a YAML test script, run it, and analyze the results with the euta engine

engine_dir.title: euta-engine folder
engine_dir.description: Absolute path of the built euta-engine repository (contains packages/mcp-server/dist). Leave empty to use EUTA_ENGINE_DIR or a sibling euta-engine folder next to this plugin's repository.

runs_dir.title: Runs folder
runs_dir.description: Where run evidence and index.sqlite are stored. EUTA_RUNS_DIR in the environment takes precedence. Empty = ~/.euta/runs

secrets_file.title: Secrets file
secrets_file.description: JSON or .env file with test credentials, kept outside any repository. EUTA_SECRETS_FILE in the environment takes precedence. Values are never shown to Claude.
